title: The small pro-etale site of a weakly etale X-scheme is the localization of X_proet
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $A$ a commutative ring, and let $j:W\to X$ be a weakly etale morphism with $W$ an object of the small pro-etale site $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] (for instance an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] of an open subscheme $W\subset X$; open immersions are etale, hence weakly etale). Then: (1) for every object $V\to W$ of $W_{\mathrm{proet}}$ the composite $V\to W\to X$ is weakly etale, and $\iota_j:(V\to W)\mapsto(V\to W\to X,\ V\to W)$ is an isomorphism of categories from $W_{\mathrm{proet}}$ onto the localization $X_{\mathrm{proet}}/W$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site] (an $X$-morphism $V\to W$ from an object $V\to X$ of $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ is weakly etale because $V\to X$ and $W\to X$ are), under which the coverings of $W_{\mathrm{proet}}$ are exactly the coverings of $X_{\mathrm{proet}}/W$; so $\iota_j$ identifies the two sites and their categories of sheaves. (2) Under $\iota_j$ the restriction $A_X|_W$, $(A_X|_W)(V\to W)=A_X(V\to X)$, of the constant sheaf of rings $A_X$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] is identified with the constant sheaf of rings $A_W$ on $W_{\mathrm{proet}}$, by the unique map of sheaves of rings $A_W\to A_X|_W$ that is the identity on the constant sections $a\in A$, which is an isomorphism. (3) Consequently restriction $F\mapsto F|_W$, $F|_W(V\to W)=F(V\to X)$, is a functor $\Sh(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)\to\Sh(W_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and sheaves of $A_W$-modules on $W_{\mathrm{proet}}$ are the same as sheaves of $A_X|_W$-modules on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}/W$. (4) If $j$ is an open immersion then $j$ is a monomorphism, so every object $V\to X$ of $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ has at most one $X$-morphism to $W$, and it has one exactly when $V\to X$ factors through the open subscheme $W$ (set-theoretically, when its image lies in $W$).
